Closely follow the established Fishius Food and Bag tile style: restrained painted cartoon shading, broad soft highlights, warm thin outlines, gentle colors, rounded corners, simple readable silhouette. Icon only, no words or letters. The space around the rounded-square button must be transparent. Output a transparent PNG.
